description: Search Indonesia's national register of laws and regulations (Undang-Undang statutes, Perpu, Peraturan Pemerintah, Peraturan Presiden, Keppres, Inpres) by Indonesian title words, instrument type and year. Returns each instrument's citation, title, legal status (in force / partially amended / revoked), enactment and promulgation dates and a link to the signed PDF, from the State Secretariat JDIH (jdih.setneg.go.id). Use for "what Indonesian laws exist about X", "list Indonesian statutes passed in 2023", "is UU 11/2020 Cipta Kerja still in force".

query.description: Indonesian words expected in the instrument's title, e.g. "cipta kerja", "pajak", "kesehatan", "mahkamah konstitusi". Optional; leave empty to list by type and year.

status.description: Legal-status filter as the register spells it: "berlaku" (in force), "sebagian" (partially amended/revoked), "tidak berlaku" (no longer in force). Optional.

type.description: Instrument type or comma-separated types: UU, PERPU, PP, PERPRES, KEPPRES, INPRES, PERMENSESNEG, KEPMENSESNEG. Optional.

year.description: Four-digit year or comma-separated years, e.g. "2023" or "2021,2022". Optional.

name: idn_search_regulations
title: Idn Search Regulations
